title: Phone product behaves like a compressed desktop webpage
symptom: Controls, navigation, or content do not present correctly during phone interaction.
expected: The product behaves as a coherent phone app with reliable touch, navigation, state, loading, and keyboard behavior.
actual: Desktop-page assumptions cause clipped, hidden, overlapping, delayed, or state-losing interaction.

rootCause.explanation: Phone behavior was treated as responsive styling instead of a required application contract.

acceptanceTests: no input is lost during keyboard, background, retry, or back navigation

title: A previously corrected failure returns
symptom: The same or materially similar failure returns after a corrective commit.
expected: The correction addresses the root condition and contains a regression test.
actual: A symptom-level patch passed once but the triggering condition remained.

rootCause.explanation: Conditional reasons and recurrence conditions must be reconstructed from commit history and tests.

actions: write regression test before replacement patch
acceptanceTests: both original and recurrence cases pass after fix

title: AI output loses or changes the requested behavior
symptom: A later AI pass omits, weakens, or changes a requirement from the source conversation.
expected: The original request remains traceable through implementation and tests.
actual: The output appears polished but no longer performs the exact requested action.

rootCause.explanation: Refinement occurred without a source-to-requirement-to-test trace.

actions: link each requirement to an acceptance test
acceptanceTests: every required source statement maps to implementation or an explicit unresolved decision
